english.title: Use / cause / permit vehicle not complying with brake / steering / light / tyre requirements at Southampton Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[used a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[caused a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_
(C)_[permitted a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) at Southampton Airport which failed to comply with the

(D)_[braking]_
(E)_[steering]_
(F)_[lighting]_
(G)_[tyre]_
(H)_[electrical]_

requirements which would have applied to that type of vehicle had it been operated on a road to which the road traffic enactments applied, namely **(..SPECIFY THE REQUIREMENT CONTRAVENED..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5(6) and 2(3) of the Southampton International Airport Byelaws, 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
use / cause / permit vehicle to be used
which failed to comply with the
braking / steering / lighting / tyre / electrical requirements
which applied to that type of vehicle
if it were to be operated on a road
to which the road traffic enactments applied.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The act in this Byelaw is prohibited on any part of the Airport to which the road traffic enactments do not apply.
